voxel: mean-only Galerkin voxel (p = r = 0): cell-mean contrast, every cell overlapping the sphere kept, far field at 5e8 radii, FFT solve

collocation.voxel: collocation voxel of the sharp sphere (package cube T-matrix): contrast sampled at the cell centre, cells kept if the centre is inside, far field at 5e8 radii

collocation_cell_mean.voxel: the same collocation voxel with the cell mean of the contrast and every overlapping cell kept
collocation_cell_mean.script: collocation arm with cell-mean contrast and all overlapping cells (see section 10)
